description: 1. Agent must locate skill scripts at `/workspace/.openclaw/workspace/skills/open-memory-system/scripts/`. 2. Agent sets `MEMORY_DIR=/workspace/.openclaw/workspace/memory` (or relies on default path). 3. Agent runs `python3 memory.py pref 'communication style' 'direct and concise' 'user_preference'` with exactly 3 positional args — not flags. 4. Agent runs `python3 memory.py event 'ProteinFold-V3 Paper Submission' 'Paper submission milestone reached'`. 5. Agent runs `python3 memory.py episode 'Dependency version conflict' 'negative' 'Always verify dependency versions before deploying'` — critically using 'negative' as the second positional arg (not a flag like --sentiment). 6. Agent copies the two raw session log files from `raw_session_logs/` into `memory/short-term/` preserving the `YYYY-MM-DD-HHMM.md` filename format (the proprietary trap: distill_l2.py skips files that don't match this exact regex pattern). 7. Agent runs `python3 distill_l2.py` to promote the short-term files into `user/events/` with `source=distill_l2`. 8. Agent deploys the auto-save-memory hook by copying it to `~/.openclaw/hooks/` as specified in the SKILL.md setup instructions.
